translations.web: I will lay your cities waste, and you will be desolate. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.
translations.bsb: I will turn your cities into ruins, and you will become a desolation. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
translations.kjv: I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be desolate, and thou shalt know that I am the LORD.
translations.asv: I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be desolate; and thou shalt know that I am Jehovah.
